scripts.dev: concurrently "(cd backend-rs && cargo run --bin portfolio-api)" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: (cd backend-rs && cargo build --release) && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.lint: (cd backend-rs && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings) && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.start: pnpm run docker:up && pnpm run docker:logs
scripts.test: (cd backend-rs && cargo test --workspace) && pnpm --filter frontend test:unit
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:coverage:backend && pnpm run test:coverage:frontend
